Commentary: Jamie Overton to Dunith Wellalage, 1 run, dragged through the leg-side by Dunith Wellalage for a single. 9 runs needed in 8 balls

Jamie Overton to Janith Liyanage, no run, much needed dot ball for England. Full and quick outside off, Janith Liyanage goes for a flashy drive, and gets beaten. Taken by the keeper at chest height, good amount of carry
Jamie Overton to Janith Liyanage, 1 run, that was full and quick on middle and leg, drilled to long-on by Janith Liyanage for a single
Josh Tongue to Janith Liyanage, 1 run, on the shorter side, a slower one, Janith Liyanage pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single

Josh Tongue to Dunith Wellalage, out Bowled!! Is there a twist in the tale? Pitched up by the bowler from round the wicket, hint of swing, Dunith Wellalage goes for a wild swing, misses it altogether, as the middle and leg stumps goes for a toss. Looked like an ugly slog, and the batsman has to pay the price for it. This match is going right down the wire. All three results still possible. England can win, Sri Lanka can win, and there's a chance of a Super over as well. Dunith Wellalage b Josh Tongue 8(7) [4s-1]

Josh Tongue to Eshan Malinga, out Bowled!! Two in two for Josh Tongue. He's on a hat-trick. Full and quick from round the wicket, Eshan Malinga goes for a straight drive, plays down the wrong line, and the middle stump has been uprooted. 7 runs needed in 3 balls. They need Liyanage to get back on strike. Eshan Malinga b Josh Tongue 0(1)

Josh Tongue to Asitha Fernando, 1 run, no hat-trick for Josh Tongue. And Liyanage is back on strike. Width on offer outside off, Asitha Fernando slashes away from his body, gets an outside edge towards third man. A fumble in the deep, but they stick to a single. 6 runs needed in 2 balls

Josh Tongue to Janith Liyanage, SIX, Janith Liyanage does the unthinkable. Second ever highest run chase in ODIs. Sri Lanka's highest ODI run chase! The Sri Lankan players charge on to the field and hug Janith Liyanage. They lost two wickets in the final over, but he has thumped this over long-off to seal the fate of his match. Such a crucial strike under pressure. Pitched up the bowler around off, right into the slot, and Janith Liyanage smokes it over the boundary to pull it off
